opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Application for stay of mandate, presented to Justice O’Connor, and by her referred to the Court, granted pending disposition of the petition for writ of certiorari. Should the petition for writ of certiorari be denied, this stay shall terminate automatically. In the event the petition for writ of certio-rari is granted, the stay shall terminate upon the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
